contribution_types.description:
Art direction: The choice of art and narrative should fit with the mission and purpose of the project. It is important to avoid choosing narrative and connotations that detracts from the actual purpose of the project.

Since the purpose of TrueSight DAO is to build a better world based on fundamental truth, and the goal is to get to as wide a swath of people as possible in terms of adoption, aliens and mystism might not be a good choice. There are sections of human society that are mistrustful of aliens and mystics 

It might be acceptable to tap into very very strong narrative frame if the goal of this project is to attract a small group of very very enthusiatic supporter. However with great enthusiasm also comes great apathy and aversion for sections of the population where these narration carry no meaning or a negative connotation
Art direction: Research into proper narrative choice provide general art framework for artist to fill in the details to complete the art direction.

User Experience: Identified 3 different target market segments we are attempting to go after

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=itETtUVqJb8&feature=youtu.be

User Experience: Proposed to split experience into 3 different apps. That will help us with the narrative and the go to market for each of these segments

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=itETtUVqJb8&feature=youtu.be
https://drive.google.com/file/d/12i_yh4caQ4yyHWwLhDXO2rijnKNp8QMc/view?usp=sharing

User Experience: Proposed to use themes for each of these NFT collections that will resonate best with each market segment

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=itETtUVqJb8&feature=youtu.be
https://drive.google.com/file/d/12i_yh4caQ4yyHWwLhDXO2rijnKNp8QMc/view?usp=sharing
Raised concern about too many chefs in the kitchen and need a strong leader to provide clear direction

Branding and storyline discussions meeting with Edi (20220701) (1 hour)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PBbhpRK7Hw4
Proposed to do a periodic checkin with Pris to ensure art direction makes sense still from a big picture perspective
Submitted suggestions for brand name

Perfectly illustrated our roll out plan in terms of markets

https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/.github/blob/main/assets/20220717%20-%20edi%20explains%20our%20three%20markets.jpeg

Competitive Analysis

https://www.predictit.org/markets/17/US-Elections?gclid=CjwKCAjw5s6WBhA4EiwACGncZUu3WksIccPqFQx9yD7H_DKlhb21kTm6HyWmDaZPfNNL8LJr8yZ52RoCqCsQAvD_BwE

Voted on naming
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1Z-putP4KztPg39g8Fay1sQcTPzvnsXmaob2R4RhEoM8/edit#responses
Pointed out that the brand name doesnt need to be trading-specific if the tagline already is
Suggested to use an everyday object as the focal point of brand name

"Requested more research into Owl as a mascot

""Affirms we are in the right direction, owl is regarded very highly in these portrayals

1) We need to see if the owl has any downsides / bad omens / unwelcome presences in different cultures

2) has an owl been used in any other trading platforms?"""

Pointed out that the brand name just needs to be first and foremost catchy and memorable, and secondly make sense to audience.
Story/narrative that doesn’t need to depend on a name.

Set criteria for brand name / logo - 
1) Memorable
2) easy to pronounce by target ethnicities
3) catchy when both read visually and outloud
4) does not offend major target audiences, ideally none
5) no major competitors with similar name
6) domain/social media availability
7) literal / nonliteral
Voted for brand names suggested by design team
Explained and described to TDG - Go To Market on Whatsapp the advantages/potential in designing for separate vertical markets
Suggested to reach out to Dean Mao distribute it in Moon Drive Camp during Burning Man

narrative.text: Edi Hsu contributed to Agroverse and MarketMonocle projects from April 2022 to August 2023, with contributions primarily in the Build Game strategy category. Edi suggested ideas without implementation details (6 times), contributed full-scale strategies with rollout action plans (3 times), reviewed strategies with specific improvements (2 times) and cautions (1 time), provided reference hyperlinks (2 times), participated in polls (2 times), and attended a FaceTime meeting (1 hour). Edi also worked on user experience through design systems (2 contributions). A notable accomplishment was delivering comprehensive growth strategies and action plans for the DAO.
